title: Vignette 2026-10-30: packages and repositories are used in opposite directions

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Owner, 2026-10-30, on whether the package registry and the repository registry are one shape: "Lets think of how this will actually get used. 
The challenge here is that I will use these in opposite ways., 

A package is a distribution that goes far beyond my own work. Packages once created should be shared by different groups. They will subscribe to it and get updates. 

My repository registry/directory will initially be my own list of repos. I will register all my different repositories with my main mcp server, and it wil let me access them all through the same interface. 

Later,  If I want to, I would publish a repo online. But then it could  get an http address as a prefix to the repo and element. 

These could still be the same mechanism, but they may not have the same content. I'd publish packages somewhere - they are static. The repos could be published too. But would also need to work via mcp"
